title: Number Match
blurb: Match equal numbers or make ten. Clear a verified puzzle at your own pace.

page.description: Match equal numbers or pairs that make ten. A local puzzle with verified boards, stages, hints and undo.
page.intro: Match equal numbers, or two that add up to 10. Clear the board one pair at a time; every new board has a verified solution.
rules: Connect two numbers horizontally, vertically or diagonally with only empty cells between. Numbers also connect in reading order across row ends when every cell between is empty.
Touching pairs score 1, pairs farther apart score 4. Each emptied row scores 10 and disappears. Clearing the board scores 150 and opens the next, larger stage.
Add copies the remaining numbers onto the end of the board, up to five times per stage. The badge shows how many remain; the latest copies are blue. Undo is unlimited.

blurb: Join matching tiles and keep the board alive.
